title: POV:

A billionaire bought
the Moon.
subs: In 2029, a billionaire bought the Moon at an auction.
In twenty twenty-nine, a billionaire bought the Moon at an auction.
Nobody else bid. Nobody knew it was for sale.
The first thing he did was put an ad on it.
It could be seen from every country on Earth.
People complained. So the ad changed every hour.
Then a rival company bought the stars.
The Big Dipper was renamed The Big Deal.
Astronomers now pay a subscription to see space.
Last week, there was a solar eclipse.
The Moon blocked the Sun for three whole minutes.
Scientists say the Moon is slowly drifting away from Earth.

hook.say: Someone bought the Moon. And then it got worse.
